card.name: Leading digits of large numbers
card.fires_on: A digit (or 'hundred') that starts a large figure in the hundreds or tens of millions, right before more zeros or 'million'. Typical in web text about populations, budgets and years.

modes.label: Digit before million
modes.description: A leading digit of a figure that will be followed by 'million', often a population or sum of money.
